traits.name: Amphibious
traits.text: The dragon can breathe air and water.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The dragon makes two Rend attacks.

actions.name: Rend
actions.text: _Melee Attack Roll:_ +6, reach 5 ft. _Hit:_ 9 (1d10 + 4) Slashing damage.

actions.name: Fire Breath (Recharge 5–6)
actions.text: _Dexterity Saving Throw:_ DC 13, each creature in a 15-foot Cone. _Failure:_ 22 (4d10) Fire damage. _Success:_ Half damage.

actions.name: Weakening Breath
actions.text: _Strength Saving Throw:_ DC 13, each creature that isn't currently affected by this breath in a 15-foot Cone. _Failure:_ The target has Disadvantage on Strength-based D20 Tests and subtracts 2 (1d4) from its damage rolls. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. After 1 minute, it succeeds automatically.
